description.text:
Humble Grape is an independent group of wine bars & shops across London.  We believe in pairing wines to curious individuals, and that everyone can create their own world of wine. We are champions of sustainable & organic wines and, as we import all of our wines direct from the vineyards, have curated a unique wine list for Londoners. As we know the winemakers intimately, all of our staff are trained story-tellers and are able to speak passionately about the philosophies & approaches that go into each glass.

Humble Grape Canary Wharf acts as a wine shop, events venue with a waterside terrace & private dining room (& of course, a wine bar!). Our kitchen has created a menu that playfully pairs with our wine list, serving up breakfast, lunch & dinner.

Be on the lookout for some of our Humble Grape activities:

- Retail Mondays, drink in at take-away prices

- Tasting Tuesdays, four wines selected around a new weekly theme for a mini wine tasting

- Icon Thursdays & Fridays, opening up two wines from Iconic producers for the unique chance to try by the glass

- Weekend Brunch & Sunday Roast
